_meta.design: per-issuer applied dollar-scale factor vs per-issuer LLM instability and rating level; existing data, no new API calls

rating_level_vs_scale.note: tests whether presenting larger absolute dollar figures (same ratios) shifts the rating level

interpretation: Near-zero Spearman associations indicate the LLM's instability and rating level do not track the absolute monetary scale within the tested [0.6,1.7] range; the decontamination's random scaling is not driving the reported instability.
